notes: Large-source-unit check: 'ad le-merachoq' (s031-s034) is rendered by the single expression 'far abroad', of which no morpheme owns a part under rule 30's subtraction test, so the grouping is retained, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme. Giving 'abroad' to the verb as a phrasal particle, as at 2CH.26.8, and leaving 'far' alone on the adverbial was the competing reading; it does not reduce the unit and is not clearly preferable.
The subject pronoun of 'he was marvellously helped' was given to the finite hiphil rather than to the passive infinitive, per rule 17.
'wherewith' is added under rule 55: no relative or resumptive morpheme stands in the clause, and the be- whose object the ASV promotes to a bare direct object is unrepresented (rule 40).
The margin's 'corner towers' was read and set aside (rule 38).
